result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks it. I only compiled the `reports` module (it compiles cleanly). I did not run any tests or try a renamed config, so the renamed case is untested.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It used to read five fixed file names, like `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. Those files didn't exist after a rename, so the read threw and `git-history.zip` was never reached. It now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, which is the same call that writes the loose `data/text/aspect_*.txt` files. Each file is read under that name and added to the zip under it.

With the default config the entries are unchanged and in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` goes in fourth place. `git-history.zip` is written whenever a `git-history.txt` exists.

I used fully qualified names for `NamedSourceCodeAspect` and `Arrays` instead of adding imports. If you'd rather have imports, say so.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 289–292) also hardcodes `aspect_main.txt` and `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. I left it alone because it wasn't part of this task.
